company.name: Heru
company.shortDescription: Heru is a technology platform focused on improving the quality of life for app workers and freelancers.
company.description:
Heru builds the community of gig-economy workers and has a suite of services that help improve their way of life and general well-being. The company's mission is to improve the conditions of independent workers by building, through technology, services, and benefits according to their needs and lifestyle.

Heru was founded in 2019 by Mateo Jaramillo and Stiven Rodriguez Sanchez and is headquartered in Mexico City, Distrito Federal, Mexico.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $6,000,000, or 77.92% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,078,582 to $25,616,550, a 12.32x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
